description: Defines an enumeration 'StreamingType' representing different streaming categories (EVENTS, MESSAGES, LIVE_COMMANDS, LIVE_EVENTS) with methods to retrieve pub/sub topics, identify live signals, and infer streaming type from signals.

classes.name: StreamingType
classes.description: Enumeration of streaming categories with methods for pub/sub key retrieval, signal analysis, and type inference.

methods.name: getDistributedPubSubTopic
methods.description: Returns the pub/sub key associated with the streaming type.

methods.name: fromTopic
methods.description: Creates a StreamingType from a given pub/sub topic string.

methods.name: isLiveSignal
methods.description: Determines if a signal belongs to the live channel.

methods.name: fromSignal
methods.description: Infers the streaming type from a signal, if possible.
